register.labelZh: BUMP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bump into 可以描述在店舖、車站或公眾活動中偶然遇見某人。；bump somebody up 可以描述某人獲安排至更好的座位、房間、班別或職位。；bump something up 可以描述價格、人數、費用、薪金和上限的增加。；bump somebody off 可以出現在犯罪故事中;bump somebody off a flight 則與航班和座位不足有關。
register.summaryEn: Bump into helps you describe meeting somebody unexpectedly in places such as shops, stations and public events. Bump somebody up can describe receiving a better seat, room, class or position. Bump something up can describe increases in prices, numbers, fees, pay and limits. Bump somebody off may appear in crime stories, while bump somebody off a flight is commonly connected with air travel and insufficient seats.

When using him, her, it or them, follow these models: bump into him bump her off bump them off the flight bump him up bump it up Bump somebody off and bump somebody off a flight have very different meanings. Read the words after off carefully.
